title: security(rbac-v2): KMS region-residency + audit logging enhancements
author: Amina Patel
description:
Summary: Add KMS region-residency (region pinning) enforcement hooks to RBAC v2 policies, enrich audit logs with KMS and residency metadata, and provide a migration path from audit-only mode to enforcement. Motivation: customers in regulated regions require explicit KMS residency and audit trails tied to RBAC decisions. This PR implements the policy checks, logging fields, feature flagging, and docs needed to ship an enforceable KMS residency control.

What changed (high level):
- RBAC policy evaluator: new rule KMS_REGION_PINNING that validates resource KMS region against role constraints; supports three modes: audit-only, enforce, disabled.
- Policy schema: added optional "kms_residency" block to RBAC v2 role and resource bindings.
- Audit logging: capture kms_key_id, kms_region, decision_mode (audit/enforce), and policy_id in structured audit events.
- KMS integration layer: safe metadata lookup for keys (cached) + fallback for cross-account keys.
- Migration tooling: linear task scripts and a runtime flag to start in audit-only mode per-organization.
- Tests and CI: unit tests for evaluator, integration test against local KMS emulator, and new audit log parsing test.

Checklist:
- [x] Add policy field and evaluator logic
- [x] Emit structured audit events for decisions
- [x] Feature-flag audit-only vs enforce per-org
- [x] Backwards compatible: default behaviour is audit-only for existing roles
- [x] Add docs and example policy snippets
- [x] Add unit + integration tests

Testing and validation:
- Local integration run against kms-local: 28/28 integration cases pass.
- Unit test suite ran in CI (pytest) and passed after the linting fix on 2026-02-17.
- Migrations tested on staging with a copy of customer policies; no policies were rejected in audit-only mode.

Deployment notes:
- This change is gated behind org-level flag: feature.rbac_v2.kms_residency_mode (values: "audit", "enforce", "disabled"). Default: "audit".
- To enable enforcement: flip flag and monitor the new metric rbac.kms_residency.enforcement_denied_count and audit logs for rejected decisions.
- Rolling upgrade safe: policy schema is additive; older agents will ignore unknown fields.

Rollback plan:
- If enforcement causes unexpected denials, set feature flag back to "audit". Audit logs emitted during enforcement include policy_id and decision_reason to help triage.

Related: ENG-4821 (policy work), SUP-1321 (customer request), also follow-ups: improve KMS cache TTL and expand cross-account heuristics.
